sentences.text: The documents do not state whether the ₹500 documentation fee once at execution under Schedule II complies with the RBI’s current rules, because the provided RBI findings are about pre-payment charges and penal charges and those directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
The agreement states: Documentation fee ₹500 Once, at execution.
The documents do not state any current RBI rule that addresses this documentation fee.
